items.q: The youngest sister was a great friend of Nell Armstrong... But with me, I would -- I'd say I like the clarinet.

ctx.x: Well, are either of your parents

Well, I had two sisters. The oldest sister, (unintelligible) L. I The youngest sister was a great friend of Nell Armstrong before she married Louie, and they would come to the house, and my mother would have a beautiful piano because my youngest sister was taking music lessons. But the oldest sister never taken a lesson, so Lil and older sister'd come by and played, and so they get up behind them (unintelligible) and play. So Nell says, well, Josephine, why don't you take lessons? Don't have no time. But she had…
But with me, I would -- I'd say I like the clarinet.
